01 / PAYMENT ROUTING

Pay the right supplier.
Through the right route.

Start with the invoice, the business deadline, and the beneficiary's required currency.

Numina's platform design connects the obligation to its funding source, route economics, approval record, and final receipt. Compare traditional bank rails with eligible digital routes while preserving entity permissions and supplier controls.

The complete payment cost

Evaluate funding, currency conversion, network fees, liquidity, and recipient payout. Compare quote expiry and expected bank availability separately from blockchain confirmation.

A traceable business record

Carry invoice, purchase-order, goods-receipt, and payment references through the workflow. Handle partial payments, duplicate requests, rejected instructions, and unreconciled balances explicitly.

02 / AGENTIC CONTROL

Automate the preparation.
Govern the decision.

Specialized agents work within a policy set by your finance team.

Invoice agent

Extract and match invoice data, surface missing evidence, and identify duplicate obligations. Untrusted invoice text is treated as data; it cannot redefine approval policy or authorize a payment.

Routing agent

Prepare route comparisons from approved providers and fresh quotes. Explain the cost, payout window, and funding assumptions. Escalate stale quotes, unavailable corridors, and inadequate liquidity.

Control agent

Evaluate beneficiary allowlists, amount limits, approval roles, and changes to supplier details. The agent cannot approve its own proposal or override a blocked payment.

Reconciliation agent

Match receipts to obligations, track partial or failed payments, and prepare accounting entries for review. An accepted instruction is not marked paid until the expected outcome is confirmed.

03 / SECURITY ARCHITECTURE

Controls belong
in the payment path.

The production design separates instruction preparation, approval, signing, and reconciliation. A model response never serves as a payment authorization.

Identity & authority

SSO and strong authentication, role-based access, separate preparer and approver roles, entity limits, and periodic access reviews.

Beneficiary & transaction

Verified destinations, independent confirmation of supplier changes, screening through appropriate providers, amount limits, and approvals bound to an immutable instruction.

Keys & data

Provider-managed signing boundaries, scoped credentials, encryption, redaction, and minimized retention. Full invoices and personal data stay off public ledgers.

Resilience & evidence

Idempotent submission, controlled retries, circuit breakers, incident runbooks, and tamper-evident audit records with independently tested recovery.

These are production design requirements. The demonstration below does not implement real authentication, custody, screening, or certified security controls.

    PLATFORM / THE VISION

    From an obligation
    to a reconciled payment.

    A coordinated operating layer for accounts payable, treasury, and payment control.

    The proposed platform connects invoice and ERP data to supplier controls, treasury policies, and approved payment providers. Agents prepare route comparisons and accounting records within explicit boundaries. Finance teams retain authority over beneficiary changes, cash limits, and payment release.

    Liquidity and market-risk monitoring support payment timing and currency exposure decisions. The workflow separates provider acceptance, network confirmation, recipient payout, and ledger reconciliation. Each stage needs its own evidence and exception handling.

    DESIGNED WORKFLOW

    Five layers.
    One accountable workflow.

    01 / INGEST

    Establish context

    Licensed market data, on-chain events, and business obligations would enter a normalized event pipeline with freshness checks.

    02 / EVALUATE

    Measure the conditions

    Quantitative indicators and scenario models would describe exposure, liquidity and uncertainty, with source evidence attached.

    03 / CONTROL

    Apply the policy

    Agent permissions, limits, counterparty screening and human approvals would determine which actions can proceed.

    04 / EXECUTE

    Route with intent

    Approved instructions would go through contracted payment, custody or execution providers. Quotes and failures need explicit handling.

    05 / RECONCILE

    Close the loop

    Confirm outcomes, match receipts to obligations, log exceptions and preserve a reviewable audit record.

    Production integrations, secure custody, compliance processes, resilience testing and independent security review are still required. This website does not hold money, place trades, or provide a live payment service.
